# clef-mail-guard

> Cloudflare Email Worker plus Xserver/maildrop warning and Junk filter. The code is MIT licensed; external services have separate terms.

Start with the README, then use the focused documents below. Examples are not live deployment settings. Never supply real mail or credentials as documentation fixtures.

## Documentation

- [README](README.md): purpose, requirements, quick start.
- [Setup](docs/setup.md): required configuration, secret handling, manual mailbox integration and cutover.
- [Architecture and protocol](docs/architecture.md): flow, signed header, thresholds, failure behavior.
- [Security and limitations](docs/security.md): trust boundaries, privacy, operational limits, rollback.
- [Repository guide](AGENTS.md): file map and checks for coding agents.

## Optional

- [Japanese article draft](docs/article.ja.md): author's motivation and integration experience; not a deployment guide.
- [Direct dependencies](THIRD_PARTY.md): declared licenses of installed direct packages.
